summary: Robo.ai Inc. (Nasdaq: AIIO), a UAE-domiciled foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K announcing a proposed 1-for-25 reverse stock split across all ordinary share classes, subject to shareholder approval, effective 9:30 am ET November 6, 2026, alongside an extraordinary general meeting set for October 26, 2026 in Dubai. Pre-split shares outstanding are 13,817,501 Class A and 222,116,290 Class B, becoming roughly 552,701 and 8,884,684 post-split; no fractional shares, with round-ups. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal consideration applies. Watch Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance and vote outcome.
